title: Evaluation Module
summary: This module provides tools and chains for evaluating language model outputs, agent trajectories, and parsing results against various criteria and references.

nodes.label: String Evaluator
nodes.title: String Evaluator Interface
nodes.description: An abstract base class for evaluators that grade, tag, or otherwise assess predictions relative to inputs and/or reference labels.

nodes.label: Pairwise String Evaluator
nodes.title: Pairwise String Comparison
nodes.description: An abstract base class for evaluators that compare the outputs of two models or two outputs of the same model.

nodes.label: Agent Trajectory Evaluator
nodes.title: Agent Trajectory Evaluation Interface
nodes.description: An abstract base class for evaluators designed to assess the performance of agent trajectories, including intermediate steps and final predictions.

nodes.label: Trajectory Eval Chain
nodes.title: Agent Trajectory Evaluation Chain
nodes.description: Evaluates ReAct style agents by reasoning about the sequence of actions taken and their outcomes, often comparing against a reference.

nodes.label: Labeled Pairwise String Eval Chain
nodes.title: Labeled Pairwise String Evaluation
nodes.description: Compares two string outputs (e.g., from two models) with labeled preferences, requiring a reference for evaluation.

nodes.label: Labeled Criteria Eval Chain
nodes.title: Labeled Criteria Evaluation Chain
nodes.description: Evaluates model outputs against predefined criteria, requiring a reference for accurate assessment.

nodes.label: JSON Validity Evaluator
nodes.title: JSON Validity Check
nodes.description: Checks if a given prediction string is a valid JSON format, returning a score and reasoning if invalid.

nodes.label: JSON Equality Evaluator
nodes.title: JSON Equality Check
nodes.description: Compares two JSON strings for equality after parsing, optionally using a custom comparison operator.

nodes.label: JSON Schema Evaluator
nodes.title: JSON Schema Validation
nodes.description: Validates a JSON prediction against a provided JSON schema, indicating whether it conforms to the schema.

nodes.label: CoT QA Eval Chain
nodes.title: Chain-of-Thought QA Evaluation
nodes.description: Evaluates Question Answering systems using Chain-of-Thought reasoning for contextual accuracy.

nodes.label: QA Eval Chain
nodes.title: Question Answering Evaluation Chain
nodes.description: Evaluates the correctness of question answering outputs against a reference answer and input query.

nodes.label: Labeled Score String Eval Chain
nodes.title: Labeled Score String Evaluation
nodes.description: Scores model outputs on a scale (e.g., 1-10) based on specified criteria, requiring a reference for evaluation.

nodes.label: Load Evaluators
nodes.title: Evaluator Loader
nodes.description: Loads a list of evaluators based on their types, optionally configuring them with an LLM and additional parameters.

nodes.label: Run on Dataset
nodes.title: Dataset Evaluation Runner
nodes.description: Executes a language model or chain on a given dataset, logs traces, and applies specified evaluators to the results.

nodes.label: Async Run on Dataset
nodes.title: Asynchronous Dataset Evaluation Runner
nodes.description: Asynchronously executes a language model or chain on a dataset, logs traces, and applies evaluators to the results.

nodes.label: String Run Evaluator Chain
nodes.title: String Run Evaluator Chain
nodes.description: Evaluates a run and its associated example by mapping run outputs and example references to a string evaluator.

nodes.label: Dataset Run Container
nodes.title: Dataset Run Management
nodes.description: Manages the state of an evaluation run on a dataset, including collecting metrics, running evaluators, and merging results.

nodes.label: Async Run LLM or Chain
nodes.title: Asynchronous LLM/Chain Execution
nodes.description: Asynchronously executes a language model or chain for a given example, handling potential errors and returning the output.

nodes.label: Labeled Score String Config
nodes.title: Labeled Score String Configuration
nodes.description: Configuration for a labeled score string evaluator, specifying its type.

nodes.label: Labeled Criteria Config
nodes.title: Labeled Criteria Configuration
nodes.description: Configuration for a labeled criteria evaluator, including criteria and the LLM to use.

nodes.label: Embedding Distance Config
nodes.title: Embedding Distance Configuration
nodes.description: Configuration for an embedding distance evaluator, specifying embeddings and distance metric.

nodes.label: String Distance Config
nodes.title: String Distance Configuration
nodes.description: Configuration for a string distance evaluator, including the distance metric and normalization options.

nodes.label: QA Config
nodes.title: QA Evaluator Configuration
nodes.description: Configuration for a QA evaluator, specifying the prompt template and LLM.

nodes.label: Context QA Config
nodes.title: Context QA Evaluator Configuration
nodes.description: Configuration for a context-based QA evaluator, specifying the prompt template and LLM.

nodes.label: CoT QA Config
nodes.title: Chain-of-Thought QA Configuration
nodes.description: Configuration for a Chain-of-Thought QA evaluator, specifying the prompt template and LLM.

nodes.label: JSON Validity Config
nodes.title: JSON Validity Configuration
nodes.description: Configuration for a JSON validity evaluator.

nodes.label: Exact Match Config
nodes.title: Exact Match Configuration
nodes.description: Configuration for an exact match string evaluator, including options for ignoring case, punctuation, and numbers.

nodes.label: Regex Match Config
nodes.title: Regex Match Configuration
nodes.description: Configuration for a regex match string evaluator, allowing specification of regex flags.

groups.label: Evaluator Interfaces
groups.title: Core Evaluator Interfaces
groups.description: Abstract base classes defining the contracts for different types of evaluators, such as string, pairwise string, and agent trajectory evaluators.

groups.label: Agent Evaluation
groups.title: Agent Trajectory Evaluation
groups.description: Components specifically designed to evaluate the performance and reasoning of AI agents based on their execution trajectories.

groups.label: Comparison Evaluation
groups.title: Comparison-Based Evaluation
groups.description: Evaluators that compare two outputs or assess outputs against specific criteria, often requiring a reference for ground truth.

groups.label: Parsing Evaluation
groups.title: Parsing and Schema Evaluation
groups.description: Evaluators focused on validating the structure and content of parsed outputs, such as JSON validity and schema conformance.

groups.label: QA Evaluation
groups.title: Question Answering Evaluation
groups.description: Components for evaluating the accuracy and contextual relevance of Question Answering systems, including Chain-of-Thought approaches.

groups.label: Evaluation Orchestration
groups.title: Evaluation Workflow Management
groups.description: Tools for loading, configuring, and running various evaluators across datasets, managing the overall evaluation process.

groups.label: Evaluation Configurations
groups.title: Evaluator Configuration Options
groups.description: Classes defining various configuration options for different types of evaluators, used to customize their behavior.
